title: Dragged clicks aren't opening widgets if they're released on the border
line: Pressing a panel widget and releasing the mouse on the panel's edge now opens it, instead of doing nothing.
explanation: PanelView forwards mouse events that land in the panel's margins (outside the containment) as new events moved inside the containment, so the edges stay clickable. Those forwarded events were built without a device, so Qt put them on the primary pointing device, while the press that started the click was grabbed on the real Wayland pointer. A press on a widget followed by a release on the margin therefore sent the release to nobody: the widget's MouseArea never saw it and was cancelled. The change builds the forwarded event with the original event's pointing device, so the grab carries over and the click completes.

commits.message:
shell/panelview: keep the pointing device when forwarding margin clicks

Mouse events in the panel margins are re-sent inside the containment,
but on the primary device instead of the real one, so a click pressed on
a widget and released on the margin lost its grab and did nothing.

BUG: 514615

patches.diff:
From e9a10b36031c67b9088c0ef8bc8c4507a9489a33 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:02:15 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] shell/panelview: keep the pointing device when forwarding
 margin clicks

Mouse events in the panel margins are re-sent inside the containment,
but on the primary device instead of the real one, so a click pressed on
a widget and released on the margin lost its grab and did nothing.

BUG: 514615
---
 shell/panelview.cpp | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/shell/panelview.cpp b/shell/panelview.cpp
index 5c0ac43e71..e2500ac604 100644
--- a/shell/panelview.cpp
+++ b/shell/panelview.cpp
@@ -1208,7 +1208,8 @@ bool PanelView::event(QEvent *e)
                                 positionAdjustedForContainment(me->scenePosition()) + position(),
                                 me->button(),
                                 me->buttons(),
-                                me->modifiers());
+                                me->modifiers(),
+                                me->pointingDevice());
                 me2.setTimestamp(me->timestamp());
 
                 m_fakeEventPending = true;
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: pressed the network tray icon (green circle) and released on the panel's bottom edge (red arrow): no popup.
With the fix: the same press and release opens the Networks popup.
Master: same drag on the Application Launcher: nothing opens.
With the fix: the launcher opens.

review.text: Excellent root-cause fix in `PanelView::event`: forwarded margin `QMouseEvent`s omitted `me->pointingDevice()`, defaulting to `QPointingDevice::primaryPointingDevice()` instead of the Wayland pointer device that held the press grab, so releasing in the panel margin silently dropped the click. Passing `me->pointingDevice()` cleanly fixes the bug across both System Tray icons and other panel widgets like Kickoff. Verification (including gdb grab tracing, screenshots, and drag-outside regression checks) is thorough.
